nodes.label: Abacus Embeddings
nodes.rationale: Learned positional embeddings encoding digit position relative to number start; enables transformers to track exact digit positions in long sequences.

nodes.label: Length Generalization for Arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Ability to solve arithmetic problems larger than training distribution; Abacus Embeddings achieve 6× generalization (20→120 digits) vs 2.5× prior SOTA.

nodes.label: Input Injection Architecture
nodes.rationale: Skip connections from input layer to each decoder layer; reduces generalization error by 50% over Abacus Embeddings baseline alone.

nodes.label: Looped Transformer (Recurrent Layers)
nodes.rationale: Transformer block applied recurrently to its own output; enables iterative algorithm execution and achieves near-perfect generalization on addition.

nodes.label: FIRE Embeddings (Prior SOTA)
nodes.rationale: Functional Interpolation for Relative Position Embeddings; previous state-of-the-art for length generalization in arithmetic (2.5× generalization).

nodes.label: Exact Match Accuracy Metric
nodes.rationale: Strict evaluation where only exact digit-by-digit matches count as correct; single digit error marks entire problem as wrong.

nodes.label: Least Significant Digit First Format
nodes.rationale: Data format where least significant digit appears first (e.g., 98282 + 3859172 = 2787472); enables left-to-right processing of carry operations.

nodes.label: Multiplication and Sorting Tasks
nodes.rationale: Extends Abacus Embeddings to multiplication (15-digit) and sorting (10-element arrays); demonstrates generalization of approach beyond addition.

nodes.label: Language Model Cramming Setup
nodes.rationale: Efficient training protocol: 8 exaFLOP compute (single GPU 24h) for addition, 64 exaFLOP (8 GPUs 24h) for multiplication; enables rapid experimentation.

nodes.label: Abacus Embeddings
nodes.rationale: Specialized positional embeddings designed to encode digit significance by applying consecutive ascending indices with random starting offsets, enabling transformers to align digits of same significance during arithmetic operations

nodes.label: Recurrent Transformer Architecture
nodes.rationale: Weight-tied decoder layers with input injection and progressive loss that improve multi-digit arithmetic by allowing variable recurrences during training

nodes.label: Multi-Digit Addition Task
nodes.rationale: Core benchmark task demonstrating that transformers struggle with positional information representation; Abacus Embeddings achieve 97.9% accuracy on size 20 training data with 6× length generalization

nodes.label: Integer Multiplication Task
nodes.rationale: More challenging task than addition with longer-distance dependencies; output length scales as sum of operand lengths

nodes.label: Array Sorting Task
nodes.rationale: Evaluates generalization on variable-length arrays with multiple numbers; tests both number length and array length extrapolation

nodes.label: FIRE Embeddings
nodes.rationale: Additive embeddings in attention mechanism used as baseline for comparison; Abacus Embeddings combined with FIRE show improved performance

nodes.label: Rotary Embeddings (RoPE)
nodes.rationale: Relative positional embeddings used in state-of-the-art models; weak for length generalization but compatible with Abacus Embeddings

nodes.label: Progressive Loss Computation
nodes.rationale: Training technique combining loss from nominal recurrences with random smaller number of recurrences; improves generalization to harder tasks

nodes.label: Input Injection
nodes.rationale: Skip-connections propagating input copy to each layer; improves performance but removed for multiplication models

nodes.label: Length Generalization
nodes.rationale: Ability to generalize to operands longer than training distribution; Abacus Embeddings achieve 6× extrapolation (trained on 20 digits, tested on 120)

nodes.label: Weight Disentanglement
nodes.rationale: Necessary condition for effective model merging where different weight directions correspond to functional changes in disjoint input regions
